externalSchedule.schedule: 08:00 start plus 5-minute same-task continuation window through 09:55 Asia/Shanghai
outerAgentProtocol: Every wake first uses the read-only status entrypoint. If the exact business date has no run, create one exact run only inside the continuation window. Otherwise reuse the one run_id returned by the workflow SQLite authority; never create a second run.
Run the public entrypoint for that exact run. Read the final compact stdout summary and the exact run-scoped workflow_handoff.json it names; do not depend on one large stdout payload.

For editorial_phase=screening, the current Automation Codex applies ai-account-editorial-director to every trusted same-run candidate and returns one candidate-local request_deep_read boolean plus substantive reason per candidate. The request is 0..N and is the only input to the existing deterministic video stage; traffic, recency, source count and persona remain evidence, not Python visibility gates. After that stage, apply the same Skill to the full pool with only the requested same-run media and write the existing final select|observe|reject|failed result. The controller never authors visible editorial fields.

Once the public entrypoint process is running, wait for that live process to exit. Do not infer a hang from artifact or file-mtime silence and do not interrupt a live process on that basis; the existing Douyin bounded tail retry may remain silent for 600000ms. The existing total automation execution boundary remains unchanged.

When the public entrypoint reports waiting_stage or waiting_stage_process, end only this bounded outer turn. The same ai-rebuild heartbeat and fixed task wakes again in five minutes, reuses the exact run, and lets the process lock either report truthful waiting or resume the latest committed checkpoint.

When editorial is required, the current Automation Codex directly applies ai-account-editorial-director to the exact candidate batch and writes the existing simple editorial result. The controller validates and commits that result; it does not author editorial content.

When scripts_required is reached, the current Automation Codex directly applies austin-voice-scriptwriter to the current rich Topic Card, its same-run raw source/video material, and the full original user materials named by config/web010_austin_private_context_allowlist.json. Those are transient writer references only; do not read legacy private Skill files, derived style rules, excerpted opening/argument/close fragments, or any historical/generated script. Write one natural spoken Chinese script from the current topic, stay truthful about Austin/client/team tests and results, compose the complete body before filling title/hook/structure in the same simple result, and return only the existing topic_id/title/hook/structure/body result or item-local material_or_angle_insufficiency. The controller owns order, checkpoint, validation and publisher and exposes one topic at a time.
Run the same public entrypoint with the simple stage result files until local terminal completion.

The owner-only publisher client reads its runtime-only config and attempts one terminal snapshot. Publish pending is not a business failure. Later continuation wakes return terminal noop and never repeat completed upstream stages, Skills, or an applied Website POST.
